verify_detail: HIP\nDefect #1 is a functional/financial-correctness bug in the checkout flow — showing a stale, wrong total is the kind of bug that should block a release regardless of how "smooth" the rest of the app feels. Defect #2 silently discards user input on a core form. Defects #3/#4 are dead controls that give the impression of being interactive but do nothing, which is a broken-affordance problem. None of these are edge-case only — all four reproduced on the very first, straightforward interaction.'
